independent_outcomes: Fix transient leaf-death classification and builder resilience: correctly identify terminal API errors in the stream, place the builder on the resilient retry path with backoff, capture and report the actual error text in build.error.log, and provide actionable exhausted-retry messages—as one coordinated change across progress.py (stream parsing), leaves.py (classification/retry/error capture), and test_leaf_resilience.py (offline verification).
